property_summary: For any admissible input, after an authorized call to transferFrom(from, to, id) on a minted token, c.ownerOf(id) must equal the requested recipient `to`; the mutant assigns ownership to msg.sender instead, so for any recipient different from the caller the assertion fails.
change_summary: Set `_ownerOf[id] = msg.sender;` instead of `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so the token is transferred to the caller rather than the requested recipient.
